program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    colors = [v for v in counts if v not in (0, background)]
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = max(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    shape = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in shape)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in shape)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in shape]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(h - max(r for r, c in shape)):
        for left in range(w - max(c for r, c in shape)):
            cells = [(top+r, left+c) for r, c in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
